name: assess
description: Deterministic decision classification over a complete spine evidence bundle

arguments.name: artifact
arguments.description: Spine report artifact included in the epistemic basis

options.name: policy
options.description: Policy YAML path or direct selector

options.name: policy_id
options.description: Resolve policy by ID from the configured search path

options.name: json
options.description: Emit JSON output instead of the compact human report

options.name: render
options.description: Emit compact summary output derived from the existing decision/refusal object

options.name: out
options.description: Write the decision/refusal report to this file instead of stdout (stdout stays empty; the exit code is unchanged)

options.name: no_witness
options.description: Suppress witness ledger recording on successful assess runs

options.name: robot_triage
options.description: Deprecated alias of `assess doctor triage --json`: emit read-only machine triage JSON and exit before normal validation

options.name: describe
options.description: Print compiled operator.json and exit 0 before normal validation

options.name: schema
options.description: Print the assess.v0 JSON Schema and exit 0 before normal validation

options.name: input_schema
options.description: Print the policy.v0 JSON Schema for authored policy YAML and exit 0 before normal validation

options.name: version
options.description: Print version and exit 0 before normal validation

commands.name: run
commands.description: Classify artifacts against an authored policy YAML file

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Top-level read-only machine contract: prints exactly the document `assess --describe` prints (operator.v1)

commands.name: witness
commands.description: Local witness ledger query commands. An empty result exits 0: `query` prints [], `count` prints a zero count, `last` prints null.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Read-only health, capabilities, and triage diagnostics (cmdrvl.doctor.v1). `doctor --json` is health; `doctor triage --json` replaces `assess doctor --robot-triage` and `assess --robot-triage`, which remain as deprecated aliases. Exit 0 healthy, 1 unhealthy, 2 usage error.

options.name: json
options.description: Emit cmdrvl.doctor.v1 JSON for health, capabilities or triage

0.meaning: PROCEED | PROCEED_WITH_RISK (risk is in the JSON output, not the code)

2.meaning: REFUSAL | CLI error | witness query I/O error (never a policy verdict)

3.meaning: BLOCK (valid policy verdict, distinct from refusal)

refusals.message: Policy YAML or schema is invalid for assess.v0
Policy selector could not be resolved
Artifact JSON is malformed or missing required assess basis fields
Two or more artifacts resolved to the same canonical tool identity
The selected policy requires a tool that is absent from the observed bundle
No rule matched and no default fallback was available

env_vars.name: ASSESS_POLICY_PATH
env_vars.description: Colon-separated directories searched first when resolving --policy-id

env_vars.name: EPISTEMIC_WITNESS
env_vars.description: Path of the witness ledger; overrides ~/.cmdrvl/state/witness/witness.jsonl

env_vars.name: NO_COLOR
env_vars.description: Any non-empty value disables ANSI escapes; assess also emits none when output is not a TTY or TERM=dumb

side_effects.notes: Reads artifacts and policies. Writes only the witness ledger (suppressed by --no-witness) and the --out file. doctor and the introspection commands read and write nothing.

policy_authoring.minimal_policy_yaml:
schema_version: 1
policy_id: example.v0
policy_version: 1
rules:
  - name: default_proceed
    default: true
    then:
      decision_band: PROCEED

notes: Policy authors can use --input-schema for policy.v0, then the minimal policy YAML example and matcher keys in robot-docs guide and --help.
Decision execution and witness execution are implemented.
Run mode supports compact summary and TSV summary render surfaces via --render.
exit_codes[].retryable is a local assess extension (not part of operator.v1): every code is false because re-running the same inputs never changes a verdict or a refusal.
